name: VSS Pulses Per Rev
desc: This is the number of pulses received from the VSS sensor per output shaft revolution (used to calculate trans output RPM). It is usually equal to the number of teeth on the VSS sensor (depending on the sensor location).

name: VSS Pulses Per Rev - Trans
desc: This is the number of pulses received from the VSS sensor per output shaft revolution (used to calculate trans output RPM). It is usually equal to the number of teeth on the VSS sensor (depending on the sensor location). See help file for more details.

name: Vehicle Speed Output Average Pulses
desc: The number of input pulses to average for the Vehicle Speed Output.

name: Vehicle Speed Output Timeout
desc: The maximum input pulse period to determine zero speed.

name: Vehicle Speed Output Min Freq
desc: The minimum frequency allowed to the output based on serial input data.

name: Wheel Speed Output Average Pulses
desc: The number of input pulses to average for the Wheel Speed Output.

name: Wheel Speed Output Timeout
desc: The maximum input pulse period to determine zero speed.

name: Driven Tire Circumference
desc: Rolling circumference of the driven tire.

name: Non-Driven Tire Circumference
desc: Rolling circumference of the non-driven tire.

name: Final Drive Ratio - VSS Error
desc: The final drive (differential) gear ratio, used when a VSS error is detected.

name: Final Drive Ratio - Trans
desc: The final drive (differential) gear ratio.

name: VSS Tire Revs per Distance
desc: The number of tire revolutions per mile/kilometer.

name: VSS Tire Revs per Distance - VSS Error
desc: The number of tire revolutions per mile/kilometer, used when a VSS error is detected.

name: VSS Tire Revs per Distance - Trans
desc: The number of tire revolutions per mile/kilometer.

name: Speed Output Type
desc: Selects what type of speed output the hardware will be inititialized for.

name: 4K PPM Vehicle Speed Output
desc: Indicates if the PCM vehicle speed 4k PPM output is enabled and it's source.

name: 128K PPM Wheel Speed Output
desc: If enabled, the PCM rear wheel speed 128k PPM output will be enabled.

name: Speed Limiter RPM Minimum
desc: Speed limiter will disable below this RPM to prevent stalling.

name: Speed Limiter 4WD Low
desc: Speed Limiter for 4WD Low range.

name: Speed Limiter Comms Fail
desc: Speed Limiter when a vehicle communications failure is detected.

name: Speed Limiter Steering Fail
desc: Speed Limiter when steering position failure detected.

name: Speed Limiter ETC Fail
desc: Speed Limiter when ETC failure has occurred.

name: Speed Limiter Minimum
desc: Speed Limiter minimum value for requested platform limit.

name: Speed Limiter
desc: Speed at which engine fuel delivery is disabled.

name: Speed Limiter 2
desc: Speed at which engine fuel delivery is disabled.

name: Speed Limit Source
desc: Indicates the source of the speed limit.

name: Number Of Cylinders
desc: Number of cylinders in the engine.

name: Cylinder Volume
desc: The volume (displacement) of one cylinder.

name: Tach Output Resolutions - High
desc: Number of periods the tach output remains high.

name: Tach Output Resolutions - Low
desc: Number of periods the tach output remains low.

name: Tach Type
desc: The type of tachometer system fitted.

name: Maximum Idle Speed
desc: Maximum allowed idle speed.

name: Idle Overspeed Throttle Closed Delay
desc: Adaptive idle may enable after throttle is closed for this amount of time during idle overspeed.

name: Idle Underspeed Throttle Closed Delay
desc: Adaptive idle may enable after throttle is closed for this amount of time during idle underspeed.

name: Min RPM Reference
desc: Minimum allowed current RPM reference in idle mode.

name: Idle Adaptive Max VSS
desc: Vehicle speed must be below this to enable adaptive idle.

name: Idle Adaptive Max VSS - Hyst
desc: Hysteresis value for Idle Adaptive Max VSS.

name: Idle Proportional Enable RPM Delta
desc: Proportional Idle correction will be calculated and updated if RPM Error is higher than this (positive or negative).

name: Idle Integral Enable RPM Delta
desc: Integral Idle correction will be calculated and updated if RPM Error is higher than this (positive or negative).

name: MAP Estimated Max
desc: Estimated maximum MAP value.

name: MAP Estimated Min
desc: Estimated minimum MAP value.

name: MAP Sensor Linear
desc: The linear calibration of the MAP sensor (slope) in pressure per 5 volts.

name: MAP Sensor Offset
desc: The offset calibration of the MAP sensor. ie. MAP pressure at 0 volts.

name: Barometric Pressure Sensor Slope
desc: The barometric pressure sensor slope. Typically pressure per volt.

name: Barometric Pressure Sensor Offset
desc: The barometric pressure sensor offset.

name: Spark Airmass Blend
desc: This value determines the blend of current airmass, predicted next ref airmass and predicted next two ref airmass to be used for spark airmass.

name: Reversion VE Baro High
desc: The Baro threshold for the Reversion VE High Altitude table.

name: Reversion VE Baro Low
desc: The Baro threshold for the Reversion VE Low Altitude table.

name: MAP Sample
desc: Allows the user to select the sample rate of the MAP sensor.

name: MAP Filtering
desc: Allows the user to select the type of MAP filtering.

name: Flood Clear Enable TPS
desc: If throttle position is greater than this value then fuel is cut during cranking.

name: Flood Clear Disable TPS
desc: Fuel is resumed when throttle position is below this value during cranking.

name: Octane Scalar Delta
desc: The difference between the cylinders will not be allowed to be higher than the set value.

name: Minimum Rail Pressure
desc: Minimum expected fuel rail pressure used in injector control calculations.

name: Maximum Rail Pressure
desc: Maximum expected fuel rail pressure used in injector control calculations.

name: Short Pulse Limit
desc: Injector Pulses shorter than this will be increased by the amount specified in Short Pulse Adder.

name: Short Pulse Cranking
desc: ECM assumes the engine cranking to be a small pulse if the injector time is lower than the set value.

name: Injector Off-Time
desc: Duration when injectors are turned off before another injection occurs.

name: Injector Offset Select
desc: Selects either MAP or VAC based injector offset table.

name: Injector Gain Enable
desc: Enable the use of the Injector Gain table. WARNING - on some operating systems this may cause high RPM operation problems.

name: Makeup Pulse Mode
desc: The mode for delivery of extra fuel injection pulses.

name: Spark Smoothing Max Torque Delta
desc: Maximum allowed torque correction, positive and negative, made by spark smoothing alogorithm.

name: Spark Smoothing Max Torque Bias
desc: Maximum allowed torque bias used by spark smoothing alogorithm.

name: Spark Smoothing Max Torque Loss
desc: Maximum allowed torque reduction caused by spark smoothing alogorithm.

name: Bidir Retard Max
desc: Maximum allowed retard when using bidirectional scanner VCM controls.

name: Manual Trans Spark Smoothing (RDSC) Master Enable
desc: Master enable/disable for the RPM Derivative Spark Control (Manual Trans Spark Smoothing).

name: Trans Input Torque Limit
desc: Maximum allowed transmission input torque.

name: Trans Output Torque Limit
desc: Maximum allowed transmission output torque.

name: Front Axle Torque Limit
desc: Maximum Front Axle Torque (4WD applications).

name: Front Propshaft Torque Limit
desc: Maximum Front Propshaft Torque (4WD applications).

name: Rear Axle Torque Limit
desc: Maximum Rear Axle Torque.

name: Rear Propshaft Torque Limit
desc: Maximum Rear Propshaft Torque.

name: Fast Torque Exit Enable
desc: Fast Torque Exit will be active if a transmission positive torque request suddenly ended and the difference between driver demanded torque and engine torque is greater than this.

name: Fast Torque Exit Disable
desc: If Fast Torque Exit is active the difference between driver demanded torque and engine torque must be less than this to disable.

name: Fast Torque Exit ETC Limit
desc: If Fast Torque Exit is active the ETC limit will be set to this amount below the driver demanded torque.

name: TCS Enable ECT
desc: Above this coolant temp torque reduction for TCS will be allowed.

name: Delivered Torque Max
desc: Maximum engine torque range for delivered torque signal to TCS system. ie. at this torque Duty Cycle Max will be commanded.

name: Delivered Torque Min
desc: Minimum engine torque range for delivered torque signal to TCS system. ie. at this torque Duty Cycle Min will be commanded.

name: Delivered Torque Duty Cycle Max
desc: Maximum allowed duty cycle for delivered torque signal to TCS system.

name: Delivered Torque Duty Cycle Min
desc: Minimum allowed duty cycle for delivered torque signal to TCS system.

name: TCS Duty Cycle Hi
desc: Below this input duty cycle traction control is active.

name: TCS Duty Cycle Low
desc: Above this input duty cycle traction control is active.

name: TCS Fail Duty Cycle Hi
desc: Below this input duty cycle traction control is failed.

name: TCS Fail Duty Cycle Low
desc: Above this input duty cycle traction control is failed.

name: Traction Control RPM Enable
desc: If the TCS is disabled due to RPM falling below Traction Control Disable, then it must be greater than the set value before TCS can be active.

name: Traction Control RPM Disable
desc: If engine RPM falls below the set value, then the TCS will be disabled

name: Traction Control Runtime Enable
desc: Engine runtime must be on for a certain time before the traction control system seeks torque reduction

name: Torque Loss Runtime
desc: Engine runtime before spark is reduced by Traction Control System.

name: Axle Max Torque Limit with Spark Time
desc: Axle maximum torque limit selection with spark timing.

name: Axle Max Torque Limit with Fueling
desc: Axle maximum torque limit selection with fueling.

name: Axle Max Torque Limit with Throttle
desc: Axle maximum torque limit selection with throttle position

name: ECM Clunk Reduction with Spark Timing
desc: Determines if the ECM will remove driveline clunk with modifications to the spark timing.

name: ECM Clunk Reduction with Fueling
desc: Determines if the ECM will remove driveline clunk with modifications to the fueling.

name: ECM Clunk Reduction with Throttle
desc: Determines if the ECM will remove driveline clunk with modifications to the throttle.

name: BTM disabled by TCS
desc: If enabled, Brake Torque Management may be disabled by Traction Control events.

name: Tip-In Limit
desc: Master enable/disable for the Tip-In torque limit function.

name: Tip-In ETC Limit
desc: Master enable/disable for the Electronic Throttle Control Tip-In throttle limit function.

name: Tip-In Torque Limit
desc: Master enable/disable for the torque Tip-In torque limit function.

name: Fast Torque Exit Fuel Cut
desc: Enable/disable Fast Torque exit use of Fuel Cut to limit torque.

name: Fast Torque Exit Spark
desc: Enable/disable Fast Torque exit use of Spark to limit torque.

name: TCS Limit - Spark
desc: If enabled, PCM will use spark to control traction.

name: TCS Limit - FuelCut
desc: If enabled, PCM will use fuel cut to control traction.

name: TCS Limit - ETC
desc: If enabled, PCM will use ETC to control traction.

name: Powerhop Master
desc: Master enable/disable for wheel hop (axle tramp) control.

name: Powerhop - Spark
desc: If enabled, PCM will use spark to control wheel hop (axle tramp).

name: Powerhop - FuelCut
desc: If enabled, PCM will use fuel cut to control wheel hop (axle tramp).

name: Oil Starvation Enable
desc: Master enable/disable for Oil Starvation protection feature.

name: Oil Pressure Low Hyst
desc: Oil pressure low warning hysteresis value.

name: Oil Pressure Low Delay
desc: Oil pressure must be low for this time to enable lamp.

name: Oil Press Warning Delay
desc: The delay for the oil pressure warning to occur after oil pressure has been determined to be low.

name: Oil Temperature High
desc: Oil temperature high warning level.

name: Oil Temperature High Hyst
desc: Oil temperature high warning hysteresis value.

name: Oil Pressure Sensor Type
desc: Selects the type of oil pressure sensor fitted, low switch or pressure sensor.

name: Oil Pressure Calculated
desc: Enables the calculation of oil pressure from temperature and RPM, only used for low pressure switch.

name: Oil Temperature Config
desc: Selects the type of oil temperature calculation and sensor.

name: P2101 Throttle Error Positive
desc: Allowed positive throttle error before P2101 will set.

name: P2101 Throttle Error Negative
desc: Allowed negative throttle error before P2101 will set.

name: MAF Sensor Frequency Fail High
desc: This is the frequency threshold above which the VCM will set the High MAF Frequency DTC (P0103)

name: MAF Sensor Frequency Fail Low
desc: This is the frequency threshold below which the VCM will set the Low MAF Frequency DTC (P0102)

name: MAF Freq Test ERT Min
desc: Minimum engine run time before MAF frequency tests can be enabled.

name: MAF Freq Test IGNV Min
desc: Minimum ignition voltage before MAF frequency tests can be enabled.

name: MAF Freq Test RPM Min
desc: Minimum RPM before MAF frequency tests can be enabled.

name: MAF Freq Test Enable Delay
desc: Enable delay before MAF tests will run once enabled.

name: MAF Freq Test High Count Thresh
desc: Number of high frequency counts above the fail frequency before MAF DTC P0103 will be set.

name: MAF Freq Test Low Count Thresh
desc: Number of low frequency counts below the fail frequency before MAF DTC P0102 will be set.

name: P0101, P0106, P0121 Perf Test - Min ECT
desc: Below this engine coolant temperature, P0101, P0106 and P0121 tests will not run.

name: P0101, P0106, P0121 Perf Test - Max ECT
desc: Above this engine coolant temperature, P0101, P0106 and P0121 tests will not run.

name: MAP Error Check 1
desc: Determines if the first MAP value is wrong if error value is larger than set value.

name: MAP Error Check 2
desc: Determines if the second MAP value is wrong if error value is larger than set value.

name: P0068 Test - Enable RPM
desc: Below this engine RPM, P0068 tests will not run.

name: MAP High Voltage
desc: Master enable/disable for MAP Sensor High Voltage tests.

name: MAP Low Voltage
desc: Master enable/disable for MAP Sensor Low Voltage tests.

name: Misfire RPM Test
desc: Misfire becomes enabled when engine RPM is above set value.

name: Upstream Catalyst Lean Thresh
desc: Below this threshold O2 sensor values will be considered lean for pre catalyst.

name: Upstream Catalyst Rich Thresh
desc: Above this threshold O2 sensor values will be considered rich for pre catalyst.

name: Downstream Lean Thresh
desc: Below this threshold O2 sensor values will be considered lean for post catalyst.

name: Downstream Rich Thresh
desc: Above this threshold O2 sensor values will be considered rich for post catalyst.

name: Cmd Gear Max RPM
desc: RPM must below this for Commanded Gear PCM Control to engage.

name: Cmd Gear Max Vehicle Speed
desc: VSS must below this for Commanded Gear PCM Control to engage.

name: ECM Transmission Type
desc: Transmission fitted to vehicle for ECM applications. DO NOT set this to manual if your vehicle has a TCM.

name: C.A.G.S. Disable TPS
desc: Above this throttle position will disable C.A.G.S. routine.

name: C.A.G.S. Min Coolant Temp
desc: Minimum Engine Coolant Temp required for C.A.G.S. routine.

name: C.A.G.S. Enable Speed
desc: Speed to enable C.A.G.S. routine.

name: C.A.G.S. Disable Speed
desc: Speed to disable C.A.G.S. routine.

name: C.A.G.S. Enable Baro
desc: Baro to enable C.A.G.S. routine.

name: C.A.G.S. Disable Baro
desc: Baro to disable C.A.G.S. routine.

name: Clutch Interlock
desc: If enabled the clutch pedal must be depressed to crank the engine in manual transmission applications.

name: Skip Shift via Neutral
desc: Enable/disable all skip shifts via neutral.

name: Skip Downshift via Neutral
desc: Enable/disable skip downshifts via neutral.

name: Shift Pattern A Type
desc: Selects the type used for Shift Pattern A, it is recommended not to change these values.

name: Shift Pattern B Type
desc: Selects the type used for Shift Pattern B, it is recommended not to change these values.

name: TUTD Mode Select
desc: Enable/disable TUTD feature.

name: TUTD Type
desc: Selects the method used to wire the TUTD switch.

name: TUTD IP Display
desc: Enable/disable the TUTD mode display.

name: TUTD UpDown Enable Req
desc: Enable/disable the requirement for an up/down request and a mode request to enable TUTD.

name: TUTD Hold Shift Enable
desc: Enable/disable a shift to occur if the driver is holding down the TUTD switch.

name: TUTD Mountain Mode
desc: Enable/disable powertrain braking for TUTD downshifts, when in D3.

name: TUTD Range Select
desc: Enable range select TUTD mode activation, otherwise use state of TUTD switch.

name: TUTD Range Select Gear
desc: When range select TUTD mode is enabled this selector position enables TUTD mode.

name: Maximum Line Pressure
desc: This is the maximum desired line pressure allowed. It is a clamp for any shift table value and has the final say on the line pressure offset before it is used on the Force Motor Current table.

name: Maximum Line Pressure B
desc: Line pressure maximum value, in some cases this value may be calibrated as actual line pressure after the regulator gain has been applied.

name: Maximum Clutch Pressure
desc: Clutch pressure maximum value, in some cases this value may be calibrated as actual line pressure after the regulator gain has been applied.

name: Pressure Pattern Select - Normal
desc: Selects the pressure pattern used for Normal shifts, it is recommended not to change these values.

name: Pressure Pattern Select - Shift Pattern A
desc: Selects the pressure pattern used for Shift Pattern A shifts, it is recommended not to change these values.

name: Pressure Pattern Select - Shift Pattern B
desc: Selects the pressure pattern used for Shift Pattern B shifts, it is recommended not to change these values.

name: Pressure Pattern Select - TUTD Auto
desc: Selects the pressure pattern used for TUTD Automatic shifts, it is recommended not to change these values.

name: Pressure Pattern Select - TUTD Man
desc: Selects the pressure pattern used for TUTD Manual shifts, it is recommended not to change these values.

name: Pressure Pattern Select - 4WD Low
desc: Selects the pressure pattern used for 4WD Low shifts, it is recommended not to change these values.

name: Control Mode - Pressure Pattern X
desc: Selects the clutch control mode for Pressure Pattern X, it is recommended not to change these values.

name: Control Mode - Pressure Pattern Y
desc: Selects the clutch control mode for Pressure Pattern Y, it is recommended not to change these values.

name: Control Mode - Pressure Pattern Z
desc: Selects the clutch control mode for Pressure Pattern Z, it is recommended not to change these values.

name: Clutch Air Purge
desc: Master enable/disable for clutch air purge function.

name: TCC Pressure Regulator Gain
desc: The gain of the TCC pressure regulator valve.

name: TCC Pressure Regulator Offset
desc: The offset of the TCC pressure regulator valve.

name: TCC Desired Slip Min AC On
desc: TCC Desired Slip Minimum with AC On.

name: TCC Desired Slip DoD Off Transition
desc: TCC Desired Slip for DoD transitoning from V4 to V8 mode.

name: TCC Desired Slip DoD On Transition
desc: TCC Desired Slip for DoD transitoning from V8 to V4 mode.

name: TCC Adapt Trans Temp Min
desc: TCC Adapt will be disabled below this trans temp.

name: TCC Adapt Trans Temp Max
desc: TCC Adapt will be disabled above this trans temp.

name: TCC Adapt TPS Min
desc: TCC Adapt will be disabled below this throttle position.

name: TCC Adapt TPS Max
desc: TCC Adapt will be disabled above this throttle position.

name: TCC Adapt Torque Min
desc: TCC Adapt will be disabled below this engine torque.

name: TCC Adapt Torque Max
desc: TCC Adapt will be disabled above this engine torque.

name: TCC Adapt VSS Min
desc: TCC Adapt will be disabled below this vehicle speed.

name: TCC Adapt VSS Max
desc: TCC Adapt will be disabled above this vehicle speed.

name: TCC Adapt Pressure Min
desc: TCC Adapt Pressure Lower Limit.

name: TCC Adapt Pressure Max
desc: TCC Adapt Pressure Upper Limit.

name: TCC Lock During Shift
desc: When enabled, the VCM will allow the TCC to remain locked during shifts in an automatic transmission fitted vehicle.

name: Use Regulator Gain/Offset
desc: This switch enables the use of the regulator gain and offset parameters. When it is disabled, VBS solenoid compensation tables are used.

name: TCC Desired Slip DoD
desc: Use TCC Desired Slip DoD tables when DoD is active.

name: Trans Stall Torque Reduction Enable RPM
desc: If Engine RPM is greater than this stall torque reduction mode is enabled.

name: Trans Stall Torque Reduction Disable RPM
desc: If Engine RPM is less than this stall torque reduction mode is disabled.

name: TCC Limit Torque Reduction Max Torque
desc: Maximum TCC Limit Torque. Should be set higher than maximum engine torque when TCC Limit is disabled.

name: Limit TqMgt Enable Trans Temp
desc: Below this trans temp Limit TqMgt will be disabled.

name: Diff Score Torque Reduction Master Enable
desc: Master enable/disable for transmission differential scoring torque reduction calculations.

name: TCC Limit Torque Reduction Master Enable
desc: Master enable/disable for transmission TCC limit torque reduction calculations.

name: Tip-In TqMgt Method - Upshift
desc: Torque management method for Tip-In control torque reduction on upshifts.

name: Tip-In TqMgt Method - CT Downshift
desc: Torque management method for Tip-In control torque reduction on closed throttle downshifts.

name: Tip-In TqMgt Method - Garage Shift
desc: Torque management method for Tip-In control torque reduction on garage shifts.

name: Flare Control TqMgt Method - Upshift
desc: Torque management method for flare control torque reduction on upshifts.

name: Flare Control TqMgt Method - CT Downshift
desc: Torque management method for flare control torque reduction on closed throttle downshifts.

name: Flare Control TqMgt Method - Downshift
desc: Torque management method for flare control torque reduction on downshifts.

name: Flare Control TqMgt Method - Skip Downshift
desc: Torque management method for flare control torque reduction on skip downshifts.

name: Flare Control TqMgt Method - Garage Shift
desc: Torque management method for flare control torque reduction on garage shifts.

name: Limit TqMgt Method - Upshift
desc: Torque management method for Tip-In control torque reduction on upshifts.

name: Limit TqMgt Method - Downshift
desc: Torque management method for Tip-In control torque reduction on closed throttle downshifts.

name: Limit TqMgt Method - Garage Shift
desc: Torque management method for Tip-In control torque reduction on garage shifts.

name: Limit TqMgt Method - Default
desc: Torque management method for Tip-In control torque reduction for default.

name: Tq Red Enable Upshift
desc: Master enable/disable for torque reduction on upshifts.

name: Tq Red Enable CT Downshift
desc: Master enable/disable for torque reduction on closed throttle downshifts.

name: Tq Red Enable Power Downshift
desc: Master enable/disable for torque reduction on power downshifts.

name: Tq Red Enable Garage Shift
desc: Master enable/disable for torque reduction on garage shifts.

name: Tq Red Skip Downshift via Neutral
desc: Master enable/disable for torque management for skip via neutral downshifts.

name: Tq Red Skip Downshift at Sync
desc: Master enable/disable for torque management for skip at sync downshifts.

name: Speed Control Termination Mode
desc: Determines the method used to end speed control torque management at the end of a shift.

name: Trans Overtemp Set Temp
desc: The minimum trans temp required to set an overtemp condition.

name: Trans Overtemp Clear Temp
desc: The minimum trans temp required to clear an overtemp condition.

name: Trans Overtemp Set Time
desc: The minimum time required to set an overtemp condition once the Set Temp qualification is met.

name: Trans Overtemp Clear Time
desc: The minimum time required to clear an overtemp condition once the Clear Temp qualification is met.

name: P0716 ISS Performance
desc: Enable or Disable the P0716 Input Speed Sensor Performance test.

name: P0741 TCC Stuck Off Test
desc: Enable or Disable the P0741 TCC Stuck Off diagnostic test.

name: P0742 TCC Stuck On Test
desc: Enable or Disable the P0742 TCC Stuck On diagnostic test.

name: P0815 Upshift Circuit
desc: Checks for stuck fault with TUTD upshift switch circuit.

name: P0816 Downshift Circuit
desc: Checks for stuck fault with TUTD downshift switch circuit.

name: P0826 Shift Circuit
desc: Checks for invalid voltage conditions with TUTD switch circuits.

name: P1876 Switch Perf
desc: Checks for upshift and downshift switch performance when not in TUTD mode.

name: P1877 Switch Perf
desc: Checks for upshift and downshift switch performance when in TUTD mode.

name: Invalid Torque Signal - Freeze Adapts
desc: Freeze pressure adapts if invalid torque signal is detected.

name: Invalid Torque Signal - Max Pressure
desc: Sets transmission full line pressure if invalid torque signal is detected.

name: Fuel Pump Type
desc: Type of fuel pump fitted.

name: FPCM Fitted
desc: Master enable/disable for Fuel Pressure Control Module.

name: Normal Fuel Pressure
desc: Commanded Fuel pressure under normal conditions.

name: High Flow Fuel Pressure
desc: Commanded Fuel pressure under high flow conditions.

name: Low Flow Fuel Pressure
desc: Commanded Fuel pressure under low flow conditions.

name: Cold Fuel Pressure
desc: Commanded Fuel pressure when the engine is cold ie. not high flow conditions and closed loop fuel not active.

name: Default Fuel Pressure
desc: Commanded Fuel pressure under default conditions.

name: Fault Fuel Pressure
desc: Commanded Fuel pressure under ECT or IAT sensor fault conditions.

name: Hot Soak VSS
desc: Below this vehicle speed hot soak will be used to calculate fuel pressure.

name: Hot Soak Factor
desc: Weighting factor between ECT and Injector Tip Temperature for hoat soak maximum temperature calculation used in Hot Soak Fuel Pressure table.

name: Normal Pressure Transition Rate
desc: The rate of change from the current fuel pressure to the normal fuel pressure.

name: High Flow Pressure Transition Rate
desc: The rate of change from the current fuel pressure to the high flow fuel pressure.

name: Low Flow Pressure Transition Rate
desc: The rate of change from the current fuel pressure to the low flow fuel pressure.

name: Cold Pressure Transition Rate
desc: The rate of change from the current fuel pressure to the cold engine fuel pressure.

name: Hot Fuel Pressure Transition Rate
desc: The rate of change from the current fuel pressure to the hot fuel pressure.

name: Default Pressure Transition Rate
desc: The rate of change from the current fuel pressure to the default fuel pressure.

name: Cranking Pressure Transition Rate
desc: The rate of change from the current fuel pressure to the cranking fuel pressure.

name: Fuel Pump Prime Time
desc: Priming time for the fuel pump.

name: Fuel Pump Duty Cycle Min
desc: Minimum duty cycle of the fuel pump.

name: Fuel Pump Duty Cycle Max
desc: Maximum duty cycle of the fuel pump.

name: Min Desired Pressure
desc: Minimum desired rail pressure.

name: Pressure Sensor Offset
desc: Fuel line pressure sensor offset.

name: Pressure Sensor Gain
desc: Fuel line pressure sensor gain.

name: Fuel Tank Capacity
desc: Maximum capacity of the fuel tank.

name: Fuel Tank Capacity Gauge
desc: Maximum capacity of the fuel tank for the gauge.

name: Primary Fuel Tank Capacity
desc: Maximum capacity of the primary fuel tank.

name: Fuel Tank Primary Capacity Gauge
desc: Maximum capacity of the primary fuel tank for the gauge.

name: Fuel Tank Sender Max %
desc: Maximum allowed percentage for the fuel tank sender input.

name: Fuel Tank Sender Min %
desc: Minimum allowed percentage for the fuel tank sender input.

name: Fuel Sender Type
desc: Type of fuel level sender fitted.

name: Flex Fuel Sensor Diag
desc: Master enable/disable for Flex Fuel Sensor diagnostics.

name: Alternator Serial Request Init
desc: The serial message value is initialized to this prior to any alternator duty cycle serial messages being received.

name: Alternator Override DC Max
desc: Maximum Duty Cycle requested by override voltage.

name: Alternator DC Min
desc: Minimum Duty Cycle used as limit for default action.

name: Alternator Default Time
desc: Serial communications must be lost or duty cycle below minimum for this amount of time, before alternator duty cycle will be defaulted to 100%.

name: Alternator Startup DC
desc: Duty Cycle used for Alternator Startup DC Time after engine is started.

name: Alternator Startup DC Time
desc: Alternator Startup DC will be used for this time after engine is started.

name: Alternator Max Stall Off Time
desc: Maximum cumulative off time due to stall protect per key cycle.

name: Fuel System Voltage Delay
desc: Startup delay before Minimum Fuel System Voltage will be requested.

name: Airflow System Minimum Voltage
desc: Minimum system voltage required by airflow system.

name: Diagnostic System Voltage Delay
desc: Startup delay before Diagnostic Boost Voltage can be requested.

name: Diagnostic Minimum Voltage Low
desc: Minimum system voltage required by diagnostic systems to trigger voltage boost logic.

name: Diagnostic System Low Voltage Delay
desc: Delay that system voltage must be low before Diagnostic Boost Voltage can be requested.

name: Diagnostic Boost Voltage
desc: Minimum system voltage required by diagnostic systems.

name: Diagnostic Boost Voltage Max Time
desc: Maximum time that Diagnostic Boost Voltage required by diagnostic systems can be requested.

name: Alternator Voltage Control
desc: Indicates the vehicle is fitted with a regulated voltage control alternator and serial message duty cycle control from BCM is available, if disabled DC will be 100% when alternator is enabled.

name: Alternator ECM Override
desc: Should only be enabled if Voltage Control is enabled. Indicates that the ECM can override the serial message alternator duty cycle to boost system voltage when required.

name: Starter Diagnostics Master Enable
desc: If enabled, Starter Diagnostics will run.

name: Number of Fans Fitted
desc: Number of engine cooling fans fitted to the vehicle.

name: Fan PWM Freq
desc: This should be set to: 2 for EV, 20 for MRF or 128 for PWM Electric and Discrete.

name: Fan Start Up Delay
desc: Fan logic will not operate until the engine has been running for this time.

name: ECT Override Limit
desc: If ECT is higher than this value, anything that is modifying ECT Fan % such as Vehicle Speed Adjust, VCM Controls etc. will be disabled.

name: ECT Fan % Adjust Vehicle Speed Lo
desc: If vehicle speed is below this value ECT Fan % adjustment based on vehicle speed will be disabled.

name: ECT Fan % Adjust Vehicle Speed Hi
desc: If vehicle speed is above this value ECT Fan % adjustment based on vehicle speed will be enabled.

name: ECT Fan % Adjust Vehicle Speed Max
desc: Reference vehicle speed for ECT Fan % adjustment. ECT Fan % will progressively reduce to zero as the vehicle approaches this speed.

name: Ignition Off Fan Run Time Max
desc: Maximum allowed run time for fans if Ignition Off Fans.

name: Ignition Off Fan Enable ECT A
Ignition Off Fan Hi Enable ECT
desc: Above this ECT, high speed ignition off fan mode is enabled.

name: Ignition Off Fan Hi Disable ECT
desc: Below this ECT, high speed ignition off fan mode is disabled.

name: Ignition Off Fan %
desc: Commanded Fan percent for ignition off fan

name: Ignition Off Fan Hi %
desc: Commanded Fan percent for high speed ignition off fan.

name: Fan Type
desc: Indicates the type of fan system fitted to the vehicle.

name: Intercooler Pump ERT Min
desc: Minimum engine run time to enable intercooler pump.

name: Intercooler Pump IAT Min
desc: Below this IAT the intercooler pump will be disabled.

name: Intercooler Pump MAT Min
desc: Below this MAT (IAT2) the intercooler pump will be disabled.

name: Intercooler Pump Fitted
desc: Indicates if intercooler pump is fitted.

name: A/C Disable RPM
desc: RPM at which the A/C system will be disabled.

name: A/C Re-Enable RPM
desc: If Disabled, RPM at which the A/C system will be re-enabled.

name: A/C Disable TPS
desc: Throttle Position at which the A/C system will be disabled.

name: A/C Re-Enable TPS
desc: If disabled, Throttle Position at which the A/C system will be re-enabled.
